EXPLORING SPACE TECHNOLOGY & CYBER SECURITY! Students from the Department of Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security) at MITS Deemed to be University visited ISRO’s U. R. Rao Satellite Centre (URSC), Bengaluru, as part of an industrial visit. The students gained valuable insights from senior scientist Sri B. Shankar Madasvi on satellite design, development, communication systems, embedded software and the importance of cybersecurity in space technology. 👨‍🎓 48 students participated along with faculty members Dr. R. Sandeep Kumar and Mrs. C. Aparna. An enriching experience connecting classroom learning with real-world space technology and cybersecurity applications!

DONATE BLOOD. SAVE LIVES. BE A HERO! The NSS Unit of MITS Deemed to be University organised a Blood Donation Camp in association with NTR Trust Blood Centre, Tirupati, and HDFC Bank, Madanapalle. Kamal Basha, Medical Officer Dr. Manikanta Naidu and representatives from the collaborating organisations. At MITS, we believe that serving society is a responsibility we all share. Every drop counts. Every donor makes a difference! ❤️

MITS HOSTS THREE-DAY NATIONAL-LEVEL TECHNICAL WORKSHOP! MITS Deemed to be University, through its Department of ECE, in association with IETE and Industry Relations, organised a three-day national-level workshop on “Silicon to AI Intelligence: Bridging VLSI, Embedded Systems and Smart Technologies.” Industry experts from Maven Silicon, academicians and MITS alumni shared insights on semiconductor technology, VLSI design, Embedded Systems, Artificial Intelligence and emerging industry opportunities. The workshop featured expert sessions, technical discussions and industry interactions, helping students strengthen their practical knowledge and industry readiness. 🌟 Bridging Academia and Industry.
